summary: Iter24: End-to-end verification of the NEW Tier Drift Monitor feature (backend + frontend). Backend: ran tests/test_iter23_drift_monitor.py (4/4 PASS) plus full regression iter18-iter23 (38/38 PASS, 93s). Frontend: full e2e flow verified — login as super-admin with TOTP, navigate to /companies, validated clean state (green ShieldCheck + 'All in sync' badge, Resync hidden, toggle hidden), injected drift directly into MongoDB (stripped 'civil_service' from Gov tenant features), reloaded → widget turned amber/red with '1 drifted' badge, 'Show affected tenants (1)' link, expanded detail card showing 'Government of Sierra Leone' + 'Missing: civil_service', 'Resync now' button visible. Clicked Resync now → POST /api/admin/companies/drift-resync fired → 'Resynced 1 tenant' toast appeared → widget returned to green 'All in sync' → Resync button auto-hidden. Verified Gov tenant features fully restored to 30 (with civil_service) post-test. All data-testids present: drift-monitor, drift-badge, drift-toggle-detail, drift-detail, drift-resync-button. No new lint errors. No CSP/console errors during the flow (only a transient 401 during the initial login pre-TOTP step, which is expected).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/admin.py drift endpoints are well-scoped: GET /drift-check is read-only and returns deterministic shape ({ok,total_companies,drifted_count,drifted[]}); POST /drift-resync is idempotent and logs an audit entry per fixed company via the existing audit() helper. Both correctly depend on require_superadmin via router-level dependency so gov admin gets 403.
set() comparison in both endpoints means feature ORDER doesn't trigger false positives — only true membership diffs do. Good.

Companies.jsx: loadDrift() is called from both useEffect AND from onTierChange — so changing a tenant's tier auto-refreshes the drift widget as required. onResync() runs load() + loadDrift() in parallel and resets driftDetail expand state, which is the correct UX.
Minor (non-blocking): the in-process resync is also re-run on every backend boot via seeders/__init__.py (auto-heal), so the new endpoint is purely additive — safe rollback if needed.
The amber/red theming is consistent with the platform palette (B84F2F + FBEBDF) and provides good contrast for the white badge text. ShieldAlert vs ShieldCheck visual differentiation is clear.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 frontend assertions passed (clean state, drifted state, detail expand, resync round-trip)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Drift monitor feature is fully functional end-to-end. Backend endpoints respect superadmin-only auth (router-level dep). Frontend widget on /companies has the 5 required data-testids and correctly toggles between clean/drifted states. The widget auto-refreshes on tier change (loadDrift called from onTierChange). Login flow note for Playwright: super-admin login is two-step — first submit email+password (returns 401 with totp_required), then a 2FA panel appears with input[data-testid='login-totp-input']; fill TOTP and submit again. Use SPA history.pushState to navigate after login to avoid networkidle hangs on the preview URL.
